name: rec-rs
description: Fast macOS screen and camera recorder in Rust, an OBS alternative reverse engineered (clean-room) from OBS Studio

paragraphs: A simple, fast, reliable screen and camera recorder for macOS, written in Rust, as an alternative to OBS for recording YouTube videos. It records the screen, system audio, microphone and webcam into one .mov or .mp4 that plays in QuickTime and imports into Final Cut, Premiere and DaVinci Resolve. It can also keep a replay buffer of the last seconds and stream over RTMP/RTMPS (YouTube, Twitch, any server) or WHIP (WebRTC), from one shared hardware encode, with or without recording.

are IOSurface-backed CVPixelBuffers that are never copied. The screen is captured at its native resolution (a 5K display at 5120x2880) and scaled to the output by a Lanczos filter in Metal Performance Shaders, which is much sharper than ScreenCaptureKit's own scaling (see Picture quality).

the replay buffer and streams. RTMP is a built-in client (TLS through the system's Security framework); WHIP uses str0m (MIT/Apache) for WebRTC with Apple CryptoKit. Stream keys live in the macOS Keychain.
